manual.title: NowGreen user guide
manual.intro: A practical guide to the main NowGreen workflows.

p: Sign in with email/password or Google. On first launch NowGreen uses the device language when it is one of the eight supported languages. A manually selected language takes priority on that device.
Create spaces such as Home, Apartment, Balcony, Terrace, Garden or Greenhouse. Add plants to spaces and rooms, keep photos, permanent species information, location and care history.
Use Green Scan to identify a plant, assess health, pests, soil or a place. Species-level general information is stored as permanent text and reused from the neutral species cache when available.

Ivy can use your plants, completed actions, health checks, pending tasks, spaces and available weather context. The Home briefing reconciles completed care with the current plan before summarising what needs attention.
Calendar and plant care plans use the same task source. Mark completed care in Actions so future checks can be recalculated. Notification categories can be enabled separately.

Create landscape projects, place objects and plants, and generate AI concepts. A real photo is optional: without one, NowGreen can render the saved plan on a flat neutral site; with a photo, it can visualise on the real space.
Green Forecast can use device location, a manually entered place or a project location. Weather guidance is advisory and should be combined with actual soil moisture and plant condition.
Settings contains privacy/terms/AI notices, data rights, NowGreen data deletion and permanent account deletion. Deleting the app alone does not delete cloud data.

privacy.title: Privacy Policy
privacy.intro: This policy explains how NowGreen processes data to provide plant care, planning, AI and account features.

p: NowGreen / NowApps is developed by Maksym Smyrnov in Portugal. Privacy and support contact: support@mynw.app.

items: Account information: user ID, email, sign-in provider, language and settings.
Plants, spaces, photos, care history, health checks, tasks, projects, scans, notes and AI conversations that you choose to create.
Technical information needed to run and secure the service, including AI usage/cost telemetry, model information, errors and security logs.
Authenticate users and synchronise NowGreen content.
Provide care planning, weather-aware guidance, reminders, AI assistance and project visualisation.
Maintain reliability, prevent abuse and respond to support/privacy requests.
Supabase — authentication, database, private storage and server-side functions.
OpenAI — AI inference and image generation for selected features.
Google — Google sign-in and Android/Google Play platform services where used.
MET Norway — weather data; OpenStreetMap/Nominatim and Open-Meteo — place lookup/fallback.

p: User content is kept until the user deletes it, deletes the account, or limited retention is required for security/legal reasons. Neutral species-level reference profiles are not tied to a user account.

Depending on applicable law you may request access, correction, deletion, portability, restriction or objection. In the EEA you may complain to your national data protection authority; in Portugal, the CNPD.
NowGreen uses authenticated access and row-level controls for user data. Do not upload personal data you do not have the right to process.

ai.title: AI & data notice
ai.intro: How NowGreen uses AI and what context may be sent to AI providers.

p: AI may be used for Ivy, plant identification, health/pest/soil analysis, species reference profiles, landscape planning and image visualisation.
Only context needed for the selected feature is sent. This may include user-entered text, plant/space/project metadata, selected images and recent relevant care context.

NowGreen reuses deterministic results where appropriate. Neutral species profiles and generated assets can be cached to avoid repeated AI calls. User-specific private content is not put into the shared species cache.
AI output is probabilistic. Plant identification, toxicity, disease, pesticide or weather-related advice should not be treated as a guaranteed professional determination.
Generated previews and visualisations can differ from reality and may invent visual details. They are design aids, not construction drawings or a guarantee of plant survival.

rights.title: Data rights
rights.intro: Ways to control NowGreen data and account information.

p: You can edit or delete individual plants, spaces, photos, projects and history where the feature provides that action. Settings also provides full NowGreen data deletion and permanent account deletion.
This removes user-owned NowGreen cloud content and private NowGreen files while keeping the sign-in account available.
This first removes NowGreen data and private files, then permanently deletes the Supabase authentication account. The action cannot be undone.
If you cannot access the app, contact support@mynw.app from the account email where possible. Do not send your password.
Where applicable, you may request access, correction, portability, restriction, objection or deletion and contact the relevant data protection authority.

deletion.title: Delete NowGreen data or account
deletion.intro: NowGreen provides both in-app deletion and an external support path.

p: Open Settings → Data & account deletion → Delete NowGreen data. This removes plants, spaces, projects, care/AI history and private NowGreen files while leaving your sign-in account.
Open Settings → Data & account deletion → Delete account. After confirmation, NowGreen cloud content is removed and the authentication account is permanently deleted.
If you can no longer sign in, email support@mynw.app from the account email where possible and request NowGreen account deletion. We may verify account ownership.
Uninstalling the app removes device-local app data but does not by itself guarantee deletion of cloud data. Use the in-app deletion action or contact support.
Neutral species reference profiles that contain no user identity or private content may remain because they are shared reference data rather than account data.
Deleting an account or app does not necessarily cancel a Google Play subscription. Cancel an active subscription through Google Play if applicable.

support.title: Support
support.intro: Contact support@mynw.app for technical, privacy, account or safety questions.

p: Include the app version, Android/device model, the feature involved and a short description of what happened. Do not send passwords.
For access, correction or deletion requests, identify the NowGreen account using the account email where possible.
For an incorrect or unsafe AI response, describe the feature, approximate time and relevant context without sending unnecessary personal data.
Report suspected security vulnerabilities privately to support@mynw.app. Do not exploit a problem beyond what is necessary to demonstrate it.
